Alright... The time has come. But what is this? Well... Is it a new main story? This story will be about gods and heroines. I've wanted to write it for a while, and it's finally here! I hope you like it. Also, today is a special day. Because today marks four years since I uploaded my first story on Koikatsu, from the "Vampire Chronicles" series. Today, four years later, I'm uploading a new series. I hope you enjoy it.
